label: V6.4.133 - MOBILE MENU STABLE
notes: Mobile menu stability fix on top of the V6.4.131 performance batch. Post-login cleanup now clears inherited drawer/overlay state only once; later safety passes preserve user-opened MENU and overlays. The active drawer restores normal backdrop CSS behavior. Mobile browser regression now performs a real MENU click and verifies it remains open beyond all post-login retry timers. Business workflow and visual layout remain unchanged.
message: V6.4.133: sửa dứt điểm MENU mobile bị tự đóng sau login; test bấm thật và giữ menu mở ổn định.
